title: Proposition and quotation verifier intake contract

draft.description: Immutable draft document with paragraph/text offsets and source hash.

authority_sources.description: Lawfully available cited texts with canonical identities, version dates and page/paragraph mapping; an empty set triggers the source-request mode.

items.description: Source/record descriptor; resolve its identity, access and content via a host-validated adapter.

jurisdiction_and_date.description: Relevant court/jurisdiction and intended as-of date.

review_scope.description: Whole draft or explicit sections; distinguish authority support from record support and subsequent-treatment research.

$comment: The host must validate nested source descriptors against its actual DTOs. This specification deliberately does not fabricate production API shapes.
